system.description:
You can take the Cast Action to conjure a Summon, a Being with HD: (your Level or lower), spending Mana to do so equal to its HD. You must conduct a 10-minute Ritual to determine your Summon before doing so. The following rules apply to your Summon:

  • You command it as an Action or by skipping your Move.
  • It uses your Cast Skill for Checks and Saves.
  • You must Focus on it, spending 1 Mana to do so each Turn. Otherwise, it is banished.
  • When it is reduced to 0 HP, it is banished.
  • Abilities that recharge or have limited uses do not recharge by banishing and resummoning the same statblock.
